name: Mechanix Wear M-Pact work gloves
summary: Work gloves with protective panels for selected impact and abrasion tasks. The black/grey model is the intended reference; size, generation and supplied performance label remain unverified.
description: A work glove should preserve enough dexterity to handle tools while addressing the hazards of a particular task. M-Pact uses flexible protective panels and a padded palm in the manufacturer reference. Check the size with the work you expect to perform, and inspect the glove after use. This profile does not turn a workshop glove into protective medical equipment or a defence against bites.

pros: Protective panels can be useful for appropriately selected general work.
A fitted glove can retain more tool-handling control than an oversized glove.
cons: Not biological, chemical or electrical protective equipment.
No guaranteed protection from punctures, needles or bites.
Current manufacturer redesign ratings are not assigned to the unverified Amazon revision.
useCases: General maintenance tasks after selecting suitable hand protection.
Handling routine kit organization and repair tools within the glove limits.
